arxiv-1511-04745.title: The matryoshka doll prior – principled multiplicity correction in Bayesian model comparison
arxiv-1511-04745.creator: Andrew Womack, Daniel Taylor-Rodríguez, Claudio Fuentes
arxiv-1511-04745.description: Abstract This paper introduces a general and principled construction of model space priors with a focus on regression problems. The proposed formulation regards each model as a “local” null hypothesis whose alternatives are the set of models that nest it.

arxiv-1810-04437.title: Persistence pays off: Paying Attention to What the LSTM Gating Mechanism Persists
arxiv-1810-04437.creator: Giancarlo D. Salton, John D. Kelleher
arxiv-1810-04437.description: Abstract Language Models (LMs) are important components in several Natural Language Processing systems. Recurrent Neural Network LMs composed of LSTM units, especially those augmented with an external memory, have achieved state-of-the-art results. However, these models still struggle to process long sequences which are more likely to contain long-distance dependencies because of information fading and a bias towards more recent information.

arxiv-2105-07236.title: A hybrid percolation transition at a finite transition point in scale-free networks
arxiv-2105-07236.creator: K. Choi, Wonjun Choi, B. Kahng
arxiv-2105-07236.description: Abstract Percolation transition (PT) means the formation of a macroscopic-scale large cluster, which exhibits a continuous transition. However, when the growth of large clusters is globally suppressed, the type of PT is changed to a discontinuous transition for random networks.

arxiv-2110-12922.creator: Valentin De Bortoli, Agnès Desolneux
arxiv-2110-12922.description: Abstract Laplace-type results characterize the limit of sequence of measures ( π ε ) ε > 0 (\pi_{\varepsilon})_{\varepsilon>0} with density w.r.t the Lebesgue measure ( d π ε / d λ ) ( x ) ∝ exp [ − U ( x ) / ε ] (\mathrm{d}\pi_{\varepsilon}/\mathrm{d}\lambda)(x)\propto\exp[-U(x)/\varepsilon] when the temperature ε > 0 \varepsilon>0 converges to 0 0 .

arxiv-2202-08677.title: Periods of families of curves in threefolds
arxiv-2202-08677.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . Clemens’ conjecture states that the the number of rational curve in a generic quintic threefold is finite. If it is false we prove that certain periods of rational curves in such a quintic threefold must vanish. Our method is based on a generalization of a proof of Max Noether’s theorem using infinitesimal variation of Hodge structures and its reformulation in terms of integrals and Gauss-Manin connection.

arxiv-2203-04856.title: Regularizing effects of the entropy functional in optimal transport and planning problems
arxiv-2203-04856.creator: Alessio Porretta
arxiv-2203-04856.description: Abstract We analyze optimal transport problems with additional entropic cost evaluated along curves in the Wasserstein space which join two probability measures m 0 , m 1 m_{0},m_{1} . The effect of the additional entropy functional results into an elliptic regularization for the (so-called) Kantorovich potentials of the dual problem.

arxiv-2207-07673.title: Hierarchical Bayesian inference of photometric redshifts with stellar population synthesis models Journal: APJS
arxiv-2207-07673.creator: Boris Leistedt, Justin Alsing, Hiranya Peiris, Daniel Mortlock, Joel Leja
arxiv-2207-07673.description: Abstract We present a Bayesian hierarchical framework to analyze photometric galaxy survey data with stellar population synthesis (SPS) models. Our method couples robust modeling of spectral energy distributions with a population model and a noise model to characterize the statistical properties of the galaxy populations and real observations, respectively.

arxiv-2308-07604.description: Abstract The next generation of telescopes will yield a substantial increase in the availability of high-resolution spectroscopic data for thousands of exoplanets. The sheer volume of data and number of planets to be analyzed greatly motivate the development of new, fast and efficient methods for flagging interesting planets for reobservation and detailed analysis.

arxiv-2507-09816.title: Compressed Computation: Dense Circuits in a Toy Model of the Universal-AND Problem
arxiv-2507-09816.creator: Adam Newgas
arxiv-2507-09816.description: Abstract Neural networks are capable of superposition - representing more features than there are dimensions. Recent work considers the analogous concept for computation instead of storage, proposing theoretical constructions. But there has been little investigation into whether these circuits can be learned in practice.

britannica-1911-holderlin-johann-christi.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-holderlin-johann-christi.description: Article 'Hölderlin, Johann Christian Friedrich' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 13), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. German poet, was born on the 20th of March 1770, at Lauffen on the Neckar. His mother removing, after a second marriage, to Nürtingen, he began his education at the classical school there. He was destined by his relations for the church, and with this view was later admitted to the seminaries at Denkendorf and Maulbronn.

pmc-11323388.title: Unravelling the evolutionary dynamics of antibiotic resistance genes in the infant gut microbiota during the first four months of life
pmc-11323388.creator: Anna Samarra, Raúl Cabrera-Rubio, Cecilia Martínez-Costa, Maria Carmen Collado
pmc-11323388.description: BackgroundAlongside microbiota development, the evolution of the resistome is crucial in understanding the early-life acquisition and persistence of Antibiotic Resistance Genes (ARGs). Therefore, the aim of this study is to provide a comprehensive view of the evolution and dynamics of the neonatal resistome from 7 days to 4 months of age using a high-throughput qPCR platform.

pmc-11484359.title: The prevalence of implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) and heart failure patients eligible for remote monitoring in Germany
pmc-11484359.creator: Jörg Otto Schwab, Boye Gricar, Tino Hauser
pmc-11484359.description: BackgroundIn Germany, contemporary data on the prevalence of patients with an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) is lacking. Recently, ICD patients with heart failure (HF) fulfilling pre-defined criteria by the G-BA (Federal Joined Committee) are eligible for remote monitoring (RM) reimbursement. This investigation aims to evaluate the prevalence of HF patients with an ICD meeting these criteria.

pmc-11543173.title: Alterations in serum levels of calcium, vitamin D, phosphorus, and parathyroid hormone in patients with clinically confirmed familial hypercholesterolemia: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11543173.creator: Kiyan Heshmat-Ghahdarijani, Golnaz Vaseghi, Shabnam Hajian, Marzieh Taheri, Shaghayegh Haghjooy-Javanmard, Nizal Sarrafzadegan, Danial Habibi, Anahita Babak, Mehrdad Rabiee Rad
pmc-11543173.description: Background:Familial hypercholesterolemia (FH), an autosomal dominant disease, is associated with an increased risk of premature cardiovascular disease (CVD). This study aimed to examine the variations in serum levels of calcium, vitamin D, phosphorus, and parathyroid hormone (PTH) among FH patients, as these factors have been associated with an increased susceptibility to CVD.

pmc-11617106.title: Body composition estimation from mobile phone three-dimensional imaging: evaluation of the USA army one-site method
pmc-11617106.creator: Christine M. Florez, Christian Rodriguez, Madelin R. Siedler, Ethan Tinoco, Grant M. Tinsley
pmc-11617106.description: Within the USA military, monitoring body composition is an essential component of predicting physical performance and establishing soldier readiness. The purpose of this study was to explore mobile phone three-dimensional optical imaging (3DO), a user-friendly technology capable of rapidly obtaining reliable anthropometric measurements and to determine the validity of the new Army one-site body fat equations using 3DO-derived abdominal circumference.

pmc-11657120.title: Microbiome-proteome analysis of gastrointestinal microbiota and longissimus thoracis muscle proteins in cattle with high and low grades of marbling
pmc-11657120.creator: Mingyan Shi, Zhichao Li, Shuaishuai Hu, Pei Zhang, Shuaitao Meng, Luyao Huang, Zhiguo Miao, Jinzhou Zhang
pmc-11657120.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Marbling is a key indicator of the meat quality of ruminants. Gastrointestinal microbiota may regulate the formation of marbling by influencing the nutritional metabolism of animals. This study analyzed the composition and functional differences of microbiota in the rumen and cecum, the differences in volatile fatty acids (VFAs) content in the longissimus thoracis muscle, and the differences in protein abundance in the longissimus thoracis muscle of ruminants with different marbling grades through microbiome-proteome analysis.

pmc-11712326.title: Neural circuits expressing the serotonin 2C receptor regulate memory in mice and humans
pmc-11712326.creator: Hesong Liu, Brouwers Bas, Yang He, Hailan Liu, Na Yin, yongjie Yang, Meng Yu, Chunmei Wang, Yong Xu
pmc-11712326.description: BackgroundA decline in memory is a hallmark of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Experiments in rodents and post‐mortem studies in humans with AD suggest that serotonin (5‐HT) plays a role in memory, but the molecular and neural mechanisms mediating its effects are unknown.Method100,000 individuals in UK Biobank were studied for the role of serotonin 2C receptor (5‐HT2CR) in the regulation of memory.

pmc-11935716.title: Invasive Versus Conservative Strategy in Older Adults ≥75 Years of Age With Non–ST‐segment–Elevation Acute Coronary Syndrome: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-11935716.creator: Amit Rout, Mohamad B Moumneh, Kriti Kalra, Sahib Singh, Aakash Garg, Vijay Kunadian, Simone Biscaglia, Mohamad A Alkhouli, Jennifer A Rymer, Wayne B Batchelor, Michael G Nanna, Abdulla A Damluji
pmc-11935716.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundOlder adults with non–ST‐segment–elevation acute coronary syndrome are less likely to undergo an invasive strategy compared with younger patients. Randomized controlled trials traditionally exclude older adults because of their high burden of geriatric conditions.Methods and ResultsWe searched for randomized controlled trials comparing invasive versus medical management or a selective invasive (conservative) strategy for older patients (age≥75 years) with non–ST‐segment–elevation acute coronary syndrome.

pmc-12406905.title: Nurse-led cardiac rehabilitation programme on physical capacity and mental health for heart valve patients: study protocol of a quasi-experimental study
pmc-12406905.creator: Juan Zhou, Yufeng Zhou, Yurong Huang, Pan Wang
pmc-12406905.description: IntroductionEvidence-based early rehabilitation intervention after heart valve surgery has been proven to have many benefits, but the experience of implementing nurse-led early rehabilitation combining exercise and psychology is still lacking. It is urgent to find a more acceptable and cost-effective method to provide exercise intervention and psychological support.

pmc-13453322.title: Chilaiditi Syndrome: A Case Report and Review of the Literature
pmc-13453322.creator: Maryam Amanahou, Zakaria Abide, Abdennasser El Kharras, Hicham Naji Amrani
pmc-13453322.description: The Chilaiditi sign refers to the interposition of a bowel segment, most commonly the colon, between the liver and the right hemidiaphragm. The term Chilaiditi syndrome is reserved for cases in which this radiographic finding is accompanied by clinical manifestations that can reasonably be attributed to it. Respiratory or thoracic presentations are uncommon.

pmc-13546213.title: Effect of Natural Disasters on Youth Mental Health: A Systematic Review
pmc-13546213.creator: Raquel María González García, Helal Uddin, Tatiana Cuartas-Álvarez, Esther González García, Nur A Habiba Mukta, Rafael Castro-Delgado
pmc-13546213.description: Background Natural disasters have a significant impact on the mental health of affected populations, particularly children and young people.
